product.name: Tennis Clash
product.description: A mobile tennis game where players compete in matches, collect and upgrade cards, and progress through tours and tournaments.

product.name: Zooba
product.description: A mobile battle royale game combining MOBA elements where players fight in an arena using unique characters.

product.name: Sky Warriors
product.description: A mobile aerial combat game featuring multiplayer dogfights and controller support.

product.name: Sniper 3D
product.description: A mobile first-person shooter game where players complete missions as snipers in multiplayer and single-player modes.

product.name: War Machines
product.description: A mobile multiplayer tank battle game featuring team-based combat and special events.

product.name: AFK Football
product.description: A mobile idle RPG football game where players manage teams and compete in matches with minimal active input.
